This '''house''' was the home of [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Mina Bonteri/Legends|Mina Bonteri]] and her son, [[Lux Bonteri/Legends|Lux]]. It was located on [[Raxus Secundus/Legends|Raxus Secundus]]. The house had a small landing pad, situated right in front of the staircase into the main building.

==History==
[[File:BonteriEstate-HOBS.png|thumb|left|200px|Ahsoka Tano and Lux Bonteri stroll through the yard]]
Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],<ref name="SWA-2011">''[[Star Wars Annual 2011]]''</ref> [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] and [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] secretly visited [[Mina Bonteri/Legends|Mina Bonteri]] on the planet [[Raxus Secundus/Legends|Raxus Secundus]] to achieve the peaceful settlement with the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]]. During this time, they stayed at her house.<ref name="HOBS" />
